name: 莊惠鈞
objective:
本課程旨在提升學生學術英文能力，課堂將引導學生透過不同的學術聽力訓練、閱讀學術文章、學術寫作練習、與學術口語訓練等，來增進學生於大學英語授課課堂中的課堂參與，以及整體學術能力的展現，並為未來專業職場上語言能力奠定良好基底。
This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium university coursework. This course will engage students with active participation in a variety of academic listening, reading, writing, and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments.

類別

        內容
        
          W17 (12/28) End-of-Semester Review
Students will independently review the course materials and organize key vocabulary, useful expressions, discussion notes, and major ideas covered throughout the semester.

W18 (01/04) Semester Reflection
Students will write a reflective report on their learning experience, discussing the topics they found most engaging, the language skills they developed, and their goals for future English learning.

materials:
本課程為專業英文（ESP/EAP）課程，教材、講義及簡報均採全英文；課堂授課及師生互動之英語使用比例 90% (含) 以上。

This course is an English for Specific Purposes (ESP)/English for Academic Purposes (EAP) course. All course materials, handouts, and presentation slides are provided in English. English is used for at least 90% of classroom instruction and instructor–student interaction.
consultation: Consultations are by appointment only. Please see Andrew's office hours and email him to schedule a meeting.
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）SDG12：負責任的消費與生產（Responsible Consumption and Production）SDG13：氣候行動（Climate Action）SDG15：陸域生命（Life on Land）SDG16：和平正義與有力的制度（Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
